description: Permanently delete skills from your Besidka account with all their versions and files, and the per-chat choices that refer to them. This cannot be undone: ask the user to confirm first and send confirm: true. Reports the ids that were deleted and the ones that were not found among your skills. At most 20 deletes an hour. Requires signing in (skills:write).

confirm.description: Must be true, confirmed by the user
